newsitem.title: USA: American Pad says Gregory Benson resigns.
newsitem.headline: American Pad says Gregory Benson resigns.

text.p: American Pad & Paper Co said Gregory Benson, the company's vice chairman of finance and director of strategic planning and acquisitions, resigned to take a job with Bain Capital Inc.

The company did not say why Benson resigned and was not immediately available to comment. Benson will remain on the company's board and continue to work with it regarding acquisitions, American Pad & Paper said.
The company also said it named two new members to its board.

The members are Herbert Kohn, a law partner at Bryan Cave LLP in Kansas City and Scott Watterson of Logan, Utah -- chairman of Icon Health & Fitness, which is the world's biggest maker of exercise equipment.
